title: Part Library rows can still be ticked and changed with Set category
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Needs: 1 user (Admin) · 1 browser · about 10 minutes
  • Build: the Part Lifecycle QA build (no build exists yet; use the build named in the test run).
  • User: [User-A], Admin role.
  • Location: [Loc-1], any one location [User-A] can pick in the location selector in the top bar.
  • Browser: a desktop browser window at least 1280 pixels wide (parts management is desktop and tablet only).
  • Data: 2 Part Library entries [PN-A] and [PN-B] (e.g. ZZAUTOTEST-PL-SETCAT-01 and -02) in category [Cat-1]; [Cat-2] is another category.

Setup

  1. Sign in as [User-A] and pick [Loc-1] in the location selector in the top bar.
  2. [Cat-1] and [Cat-2] = two different categories from the Category list.
  3. Create [PN-A]: go to Parts → Inventory, click New Inventory Part, type Description "ZZAUTOTEST PL set category A" and Part Number ZZAUTOTEST-PL-SETCAT-01 (examples), pick [Cat-1], type Cost (e.g. 10.00) and Sell Price (e.g. 20.00), leave "Track quantities and cost of goods" on, keep the default bin with Quantity 5, and click Save. [PN-A] = the part number you typed.
  4. Create [PN-B]: go to Parts → Inventory, click New Inventory Part, type Description "ZZAUTOTEST PL set category B" and Part Number ZZAUTOTEST-PL-SETCAT-02 (examples), pick [Cat-1], type Cost (e.g. 10.00) and Sell Price (e.g. 20.00), leave "Track quantities and cost of goods" on, keep the default bin with Quantity 5, and click Save. [PN-B] = the part number you typed.
  5. Check the setup worked: Parts → Part Library searched for ZZAUTOTEST-PL-SETCAT lists [PN-A] and [PN-B], both in [Cat-1].
custom_steps:
1. In the top bar click Parts, then click Part Library in the left menu.
  2. Type ZZAUTOTEST-PL-SETCAT in the Search box.
  3. Click the checkbox of the [PN-A] row.
  4. Click the checkbox of the [PN-B] row.
  5. Click the ⋮ icon at the left end of the table's header row.
  6. Click Set category.
  7. Pick [Cat-2].
  8. Click the button that applies it (e.g. Save).
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Steps 3 and 4: Both rows can be ticked.
  • Step 5: The menu offers "Set category".
  • Step 8: Both [PN-A] and [PN-B] now show [Cat-2] in the Category column.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10647; story SV-10824 (Story 11, The Part Library Is Browse and Edit Only); PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, v26 (Ready for dev), S11-R4, read 8 Oct 2026; design canvas board 7.1 (Part Library).
